description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 16.03.2015 to 22.03.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
